_readme: Rules for turning Katy's private Google Calendar into the public schedule. Events matching a class rule are shown with the class's public details. Every other timed event that blocks her time shows only as an anonymous 'Booked' block (no title, no names). All-day events and events marked 'Free' in Google Calendar are hidden. Never add student names here.
early_roster_note: Some classes don't open for sign-up until closer to the date. Want a spot now? Text me and I'll put you on the roster early.
